newsitem.title: GERMANY: Altana reports 14 pct rise in 96 sales.
newsitem.headline: Altana reports 14 pct rise in 96 sales.

text.p: German drugs and chemicals group Altana AG said on Thursday that acquisitions helped its sales climb 14 percent to 2.3 billion marks in 1996 with profits expected to outpace the rise in sales.
Altana said the rise in profits, as compared with last year's pre-tax group profits at 202 million marks, will likely be above the rise in sales.
In light of strong results, Altanta said it expected to pay a higher dividend for 1996 and also expected double-digit sales and profit growth in 1997.
"We expect to see ongoing strong developments which will translate into sales and profit growth showing increases of at least 10 percent," the group said.

Last year Altana paid a 13.50 mark ($8.18) dividend on shares nominally valued at 50 marks. Following a nationwide trend to attract private investors to the share market, Altana plans to reduce the nominal value of its shares to five marks after the general meeting in May.
